sampler.note: Demo-size problem (16 samples, 4 cell types, 3 programs, 400 genes), 4 chains x 400 draws. Efficiency = effective samples per 1000 gradient evaluations (higher is better). The zero-sum parameterisation (reparam=True) halves the steps and is about 1.3-1.6x more efficient for fractions and program shifts but less for the worst treatment effect; centred variants were worse and were not adopted. On a 60-sample problem reparam=True still needed 511 steps per iteration, so it is not the fix for large data.
